<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-DEV-006</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Devices</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Server log; HTTP 429 to the device</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Transport feature disabled for tenant - message rejected (limit exceeded)</span></div>

## Why it happens

The tenant reached its monthly transport messages or data points quota in the tenant profile. The **API usage** page shows the counter as **Disabled**.

## Fix it

Wait for the next month, or ask the system administrator to raise the quota in the tenant profile.

## Check that it worked

The **API usage** page shows **Transport** as **Enabled** again.
